payload.title: Right now: what an operator sees at a glance
payload.description: Drill-down 1 of the Kanbus observability series (anchor: ANTH-a76a4a). The automated right-now status line per issue: one real board, one day, the status lines as they changed, and what an operator can act on from them. Use real generated output from a board where the feature has run; this needs a model key, so pick the board that has it. Honest about what the line gets wrong.
